text:
DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSES  OF AN UNCONSCIOUS PATIENT
- Stroke
- Post-epilepsy state
- Syncope
- Myocardial infarction
- Conversion disorder (hysteria)
- Substance abuse
- Locked-in state
- Minimal conscious state
- Persistent vegetative state
- Akinetic mutism and abulia
